description: Reviewed evidence (2026-11-10; schema extended 2026-11-11 for policy 3) that establishes the basis of a treat rate or dose recorded with a bare '%'. Each entry gives basis_class (mass or volume), evidence_kind (unit, heading, footnote, text or document_convention), scope (value, table or document), the page and the quoted wording. Only cases where the source states the basis for the recorded number are listed; the basis is never guessed, and the recorded unit in the product JSON stays as printed.
not_established: All other bare-'%' treat rates found by the scan (Afton HiTEC 12200 dosage table, HiTEC 8766B/8767B, HiTEC 12250 (external PDS), Eni MX 5212/5217, Bettchem BT 3088, Minglan T3161 (no unit printed), Richful RF6066/6069/6071L/6077/6078/6088/6088F/6400/6406/6408): the cited page prints no basis for the dosage figures. The Afton 12200 footnote 3 'Up to 0.6% wt maybe required for some group I's' applies to one booster row only and does not establish the basis of the table.

document_wide_conventions: Searched 2026-11-11 with treat_rate_basis_scan.py (column document_wide_convention_leads): every page of the 20 archive documents that carry a dose without a mass unit (19 have a text layer; DL2-10218.pdf is image-only and was read on its render on 2026-11-10). No document states a document-wide percentage convention. The one lead, DL2-12029.pdf p.1 'the recommended treat rate of 11.9 mass%', is a statement about that treat rate, which is already recorded in wt.%, and the page is already listed below for its co-component dose. The two external sources (Afton HiTEC 12250 data sheet, not obtained; Richful page 130) are outside that search.
